text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I changed up my route for a change of pace... and ended up all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Were you fishing?
For tonight's dinner?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...No. Um... I just kind of like it.
Casting a line and zoning out...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, a member of my clan once told me.
Waiting continuously with a tranquil mind...
Fishing serves as a form of mental training."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... Would you mind if I
observed that training?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
................
U-Um... would you like to try fishing...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—Here it comes!
......Ugh, it got away again...!”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is tough...
Before I can reel it in, it gets away...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps...
even the slightest change in how firmly I hold the rod
is being sensed by the fish.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Relax... a bit more. Expand your awareness...
and feel it. The movement of the fish...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Relax... and feel it.
The swaying waves... weaving through the gaps between them—!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see, so this is what that feeling is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps fishing had sharpened her senses.
After that, Duramente's running had noticeably more edge to it!
